description: Holds factory product requisition details records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to factory category, factory products.
business_purpose: Used to track and report factory product requisition details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: FactoryProductRequisitionHeaderid
columns.description: Factory product requisition headerid of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: batch
columns.description: Batch of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: buying_price
columns.description: Buying price of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: categoryid
columns.description: Reference to the factory category linked to this factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: last_bought_price
columns.description: Last bought price of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Reference to the factory products linked to this factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Quantity of the factory product requisition detail.

columns.name: total_price
columns.description: Total price of the factory product requisition detail.

relationships.description: Each factory product requisition detail references one factory category (category).
Each factory product requisition detail references one factory products (product).

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
Use total_price / quantity for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Factory Category, Factory Products through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
FactoryProductRequisitionDetails is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.
common_queries: Factory Product Requisition Details by factory category
Factory Product Requisition Details by factory products
Top factory category by buying price

known_issues: buying_price, last_bought_price, total_price are stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
buying_price, last_bought_price, quantity, total_price are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against FactoryProductRequisitionDetails: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting factory product requisition detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_price) for totals of total price.
To resolve names, join on: categoryid = FactoryCategory.id; productid = FactoryProducts.id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
